'''Yoav Shechtman''' ({{langx|he|יואב שכטמן}}; born March 17, 1980) is an Israeli physicist and engineer. He heads the Nano-Bio-Optics lab at the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology]].

==Early life and education==
Yoav Shechtman was born on March 17, 1980, to Zipora and [[Dan Shechtman]] and spent his childhood growing up in [[Haifa]].

Shechtman holds a BSc in physics and electrical engineering (2007) and a PhD in physics (2013) from the [[Technion]]. He later completed a postdoc at [[Stanford University]] (2016), developing [[super-resolution microscopy]] methods with [[W.E. Moerner]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://biomed.faculty-ms.technion.ac.il/members/yoav-shechtman/|title=Yoav Shechtman - Technion Faculty of Biomedical Engineering|access-date=16 April 2020|archive-date=27 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171027053704/http://biomed.faculty-ms.technion.ac.il/members/yoav-shechtman/}}</ref>

==Academic career==
Since October 2016, Shechtman is a faculty member in the [[Technion-Israel Institute of Technology]] where he currently heads the Nano-Bio-Optics lab.<ref name="makor-rishon">{{cite web |last= |first= |date=29 November 2024 |title=Nano Bio Optics lab at the Technion |url=https://www.clever-microscopy.com/ |access-date=29 November 2024 |website=www.clever-microscopy.com |publisher= |language=}}</ref><ref name="ismbe">{{cite web|url=https://ismbe.org.il/announcements/|title=Israel Society for Medical and Biological Engineering - Announcements|access-date=16 April 2020|archive-date=26 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201226125811/http://ismbe.org.il/announcements/}}</ref>

In 2018, Shechtman and his team at the Technion developed an efficient method for bio imaging in super resolution.<ref name="hayadan">{{cite web|language=he|url=https://www.hayadan.org.il/life-in-super-resolution-0206182|title=Life in Super Resolution|publisher=HaYadan|date=2 June 2018|access-date=16 April 2020}}</ref>

In 2021, Shechtman, in collaboration with Reut Orange-Kedem, developed a cheap and more efficient method for the production of more precise optical components.<ref name="ynet-june-2021">{{cite news |title=Research: The "Trick" That Helps to Develop Precise Optical Components |url=https://www.ynet.co.il/environment-science/article/HyouIbIod |newspaper=[[Ynet]] |access-date=23 April 2022 |language=he |date=15 June 2021}}</ref>

From September 2023 – 2024, Shechtman was a Harrington Faculty Fellow at [[University of Texas at Austin|The University of Texas]]<ref name="university-of-texas">{{cite web |title=Faculty Directory |url=https://www.me.utexas.edu/people/faculty-directory/adjunct-faculty |publisher=[[University of Texas at Austin]] |access-date=7 September 2023}}</ref> at Austin.

In May 2025, Shechtman was selected as a member of the Israel Young Academy.<ref name="israel-young-academy">{{cite web |title=Nine leading scientists elected to membership in the Young Israeli Academy |url=https://young.academy.ac.il/News/NewsItem.aspx?nodeId=658&id=688 |publisher=Israel Young Academy |access-date=18 May 2025 |language=he |date=14 May 2025}}</ref>

==Awards==
* 2016 Technion Career Advancement Chair
* 2017 Zuckerman Faculty Scholar
* 2018 Early Career Award of the International Association for Medical and Biological Engineering (IAMBE)
* 2018 [[European Research Council]] starting grant
* 2019 Uzi and Michal Halevy Award for Innovative Applied Engineering
* 2020 IUPAB Young Investigator Medal and Prize<ref name="iupab">{{cite web |date=4 April 2020 |title=The first Edition of the IUPAB Young Investigator Medal and Prize has been awarded to Dr Yoav Shechtman |url=http://iupab.org/2020/04/04/the-first-edition-of-the-iupab-young-investigator-prize-has-been-awarded-to-dr-yoav-shechtman/ |access-date=16 April 2020 |archive-date=11 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200811131657/http://iupab.org/2020/04/04/the-first-edition-of-the-iupab-young-investigator-prize-has-been-awarded-to-dr-yoav-shechtman/ }}</ref>
* 2021 Krill Prize
* 2024 [[European Research Council]] Proof of Concept (ERC PoC) grants [https://bme.technion.ac.il/en/news/congratulations-to-prof-yoav-shechtman-and-prof-netanel-korin-on-recieving-the-european-research-council-proof-of-concept-erc-poc-grants/ .2]
